family.description: This entry represents a CBM domain, a member of CBM96 family, found in functionally diverse multi-domain proteins including tRNA nuclease WapA, alginate lyase from Defluviitalea phaphyphila and chondroitinase from Dysgonomonas sp. The CBM96 domain from the latter proteins, has been structurally characterised. It fold into a beta-sandwich with significant structural similarity to nucleoplasmin (PDB:8WAB, PDB:7VBO) [[cite:PUB00159883]].
family.name: Carbohydrate-binding module family 96
